speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I see you are here for episodic cough and shortness of breath; to help you, I need to know when these symptoms first started and if anything specific, like exercise or allergens, seems to trigger them.

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma.

The patient is a 59-year-old female with a one-month history of nonproductive cough and shortness of breath that worsens with exertion and at night. Given her age, the nature of the symptoms, and the preceding viral-like illness 8 weeks ago, I suspect she has developed post-viral reactive airway disease or adult-onset asthma.

REQUEST TEST: Spirometry_with_reversibility_testing
